name: Gesshoku Meikyuuro
source: This is an 18+ game featuring Asu and Kira. It’s a version with two story paths to choose from based on your initial decision: whether Asu becomes a butler or Kira becomes a maid. Other characters make brief appearances as well, so stay tuned!
